excerpts.label: Fed priority: deficit first
excerpts.insight: Fed's real order: funding the deficit, then jobs, then inflation. Treasury/Fed working together isn't new—just not transparent.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Fed won't fight inflation if it threatens funding. STAY LONG risk assets until deficit dynamics change.

excerpts.label: 30Y is the real signal
excerpts.insight: 30-year less liquid, less well behaved. Treasury starving duration = 70-80bps compression on 10Y. Watch 30Y spot and dollar for stress.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: WATCH 30Y yields, not 10Y. Dollar weakness = emerging market funding pattern. TLT puts as hedge.

excerpts.label: Employment bottomed April
excerpts.insight: Out-of-consensus call: employment troughed April. Private improving, government coming down. Inflation good for stocks if Fed dormant.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BULLISH US equities. Rolling recession over. Inflation 2.5-3% tolerated = sweet spot.

excerpts.label: No hiring = margins explode
excerpts.insight: No hiring, no firing setup. Revenue up, headcount flat = best earnings growth since 2021. Productivity up 4% (6-year high).
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG equal-weight over cap-weight. Margin expansion broadening to mid-tier.

excerpts.label: AI threat changes behavior
excerpts.insight: AI isn't impacting margins yet, but threat of AI is changing corporate behavior. White-collar firms won't rush to hire.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: AI productivity = 40bps modeled. The threat matters more than current tools.

excerpts.label: Breath divergence 10-12%
excerpts.insight: S&P vs 200-day vs stocks above 200-day shows 10-12% gap. Either breath improves or 5-10% correction coming.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: MONITOR breath resolution. Not 20% correction—but 5-10% possible. Buy dips.
